title: 3 Illusions Your Brain Can't Unsee 🤯 #shorts
description:
These lines are perfectly straight... so why does every row look tilted? Three classic optical illusions (café wall, stepping feet and simultaneous contrast), explained in under a minute.

Subscribe for a new brain glitch every day.

#opticalillusion #illusion #brain #psychology #science #shorts

segments.text: But your brain refuses to believe it. Every row looks tilted, right?
Watch what happens when I lay a ruler across.
Dead straight. The shifted tiles fool the edge detectors in your eyes.
Now look at these two blocks. They take turns, like feet walking.
and they were moving together the entire time.
Last one. Which square is darker? A, or B?
Neither. They're the exact same grey. Connect them, and the trick falls apart.
